scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.vercel-build: pnpm --filter @workspace/inventario-ventas run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server exec node ./build-vercel-handler.mjs && rm -rf public && cp -r artifacts/inventario-ventas/dist/public ./public && echo '=== ROOT DIR ===' && ls -la && echo '=== PUBLIC DIR ===' && ls -la public
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
